note: Which catalogue foods are parts of a whole food, for the finder: a stock item of the whole (or of a food below it) covers a dish line that names the part exactly, with no amount (the whole's amount says nothing exact about the part's). The USDA data says nothing of parts; every entry is a judgement of the person who wrote it, stated in `basis`, never derived from a name.

entries.basis: A judgement of the project, no source looked up: inside the shell a whole egg is its white and its yolk, and a cook separates one egg into one white and one yolk. Dried whites and yolks are not parts of a fresh egg and are not listed.
